findings.description: Linking.openURL with unvalidated URL - may open malicious schemes (tel:, sms:, custom://)
findings.suggestion: Validate URL scheme against an allowlist before calling Linking.openURL. Use Linking.canOpenURL() first and restrict to https:// URLs.

findings.description: WebView onMessage handler does not validate message origin
findings.snippet:
<ScreenShell>
        {( !params.loggedIn || source.headers ) && (
          <WebView
            // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-empty-function
            onMessage={() => { }} // onMessage prop required to inject JS into webview
findings.suggestion: Always validate event.nativeEvent.url or message origin before processing postMessage data

findings.description: WebView loading external content without security headers
findings.snippet:

findings.suggestion: Add security headers to WebView source: X-Frame-Options, Content-Security-Policy. Validate origin of loaded content.

findings.description: "inaturalistjs" in dependencies uses git dependency pinned to a commit or tag: "github:inaturalist/inaturalistjs#e1bef3c5ab3a73d98673230ae3d0770fa8d436b4"
findings.reason: Code fetched from git or a URL bypasses registry integrity and provenance checks, and a moving branch or tag can change under you.
findings.suggestion: Publish and install "inaturalistjs" from your registry, or pin the git dependency to a full 40-character commit SHA.
